name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted AT Protocol Personal Data Server that hosts your Bluesky accounts, posts and media and federates them with the Bluesky network.

alerts.message: No account exists after deploy and sign-up requires an invite code. Create the first account with `goat pds admin account create` (or an invite code with `goat pds admin create-invites`) from a terminal in the pds container.

Handles under the PDS domain (e.g. alice.<your-domain>) only resolve when a wildcard DNS record and route point to this service. Without it, create the account under the PDS domain anyway, then change its handle to a domain you own (DNS TXT record) in the Bluesky app settings.
The PDS must be served over HTTPS on a stable domain. Changing the domain after accounts are created breaks their identities on the network.
